aligned_window: anchor pose row i: V0=row i+1; rewards=row i+1..j inclusive; endpoint V=row j+1; j selected by timestamp at anchor+2.0 s
auxiliary_terminal_return: true terminal: bootstrap 0. timeout: PPO adds gamma*V(preterminal) to final reward, equivalent to gamma**N*V(preterminal) beyond raw discounted sum
collector_critic: V(s_t), evaluated from obs before env.step(action_t)
collector_pose: s_{t+1} snapshot after step; terminal row snapshot is pre-reset
collector_reward: raw env reward for s_t -> s_{t+1}, recorded in the same row as action_t; PPO timeout correction is not applied by collector
collector_timestamp: (global_step+1)*step_dt, identifies reward/pose endpoint; critic corresponds one control step earlier
current_quality: Critic P10 uses same-row pre-action values across anchor to horizon, preserved exactly rather than silently realigned
reset_boundary_rule: never use next episode row for endpoint value
terminal_endpoint_value: not recorded; primary V-end-dependent labels are null for 29 windows
timeout_bootstrap_training: is_finite_horizon=false; wrapper exports time_outs and PPO.process_env_step corrects reward using gamma*transition.values
